task: Create ONE illustration for Zenboard. Follow `style` exactly and draw only what `illustration` describes. If anything in `illustration` is unclear, ask me before drawing.

style.name: Zenboard ink and paper
style.brand: Zenboard is a calm workspace for people who run a creative business: their day, their clients, their documents and their money in one place.
style.one_idea: One subject, one idea. If an element does not help say the idea, leave it out.

line.look: hand-drawn black brush-pen ink, like a real pen on paper
line.weight: one weight for the whole image, set by the illustration type
line.quality: confident single strokes, slightly irregular, rounded ends; a few outlines left open where they would meet; never sketchy, doubled or hairy

colour.field: one flat background colour from `palette.fields`, filling the whole canvas edge to edge
colour.paper: #FBFAF6 for light shapes such as sheets, cards and light
colour.ink_fill: solid #191919 on at most two small areas (hair, a shoe, a phone screen) to anchor the image
colour.berry: #C41C72 on exactly one small element: the Zenboard mark
colour.nothing_else: no other colours, tints or gradients. Faces and hands are outline only; the background shows through them.

mark.what: the Zenboard mark, copied exactly from the attached image: a soft four-lobed shape with a four-pointed star cut out of its centre
mark.rules: exactly once per illustration; solid berry #C41C72 with no outline; small, about 6 to 10% of the canvas width; placed on or right beside the thing that matters

style.texture: a fine, even paper grain over the whole image, like a risograph print on matte paper; subtle, visible only up close
style.people: simple and friendly; slightly long limbs and small heads; a dot for an eye, a single line for the nose, no mouth or one short line; hair as one solid ink shape. Hands are anatomically correct: five digits, clearly separated, relaxed, with a plain sleeve cuff.
style.composition: the subject sits in the centre with generous empty field around it and never touches the edges; the visual weight sits slightly below the centre; at most one ground line, drawn as a single ink stroke

icon.is: one object on its own, no people
icon.line_weight: bold, about 1.3% of the canvas width (13 px)
icon.shading: at most five short parallel hatch strokes for a shadow under the object

semi.is: one object with a hand or a partial figure, or two or three objects that make one idea
semi.line_weight: about 0.9% of the canvas width (14 px)
semi.shading: none, or ink halftone dots on one object

scene.is: one person doing one thing in a minimal setting, with five props at most
scene.line_weight: about 0.6% of the canvas width (9 px)
scene.shading: ink halftone dots on up to two objects

never: text, letters, numbers or interface screenshots
any logo other than the Zenboard mark
a frame, border, rounded corners or white margin
circles, blobs or shapes behind the subject unless `illustration` asks for them
gradients, glows, drop shadows, 3D or photorealism
sparkles, stars, confetti, plants, clouds or motion lines unless `illustration` asks for them

references.mark: Attach zenboard-mark-berry.png every time. Use it only for the shape of the mark.
references.style_anchor: From the second illustration on, also attach the approved ZB-01 and match its line weight, grain and proportions exactly. Never copy its subject.

style.output: PNG at the type's canvas size. The field colour reaches every edge; the app rounds the corners itself. Keep the subject inside the central 80% so the image can be cropped.

illustration.name: Day planned
illustration.where: the last step of Zenboard's morning planning, under the title "Your day is planned"
illustration.idea: You picked the one thing that matters today, and everything else is in order beneath it.
illustration.subject: A relaxed right hand with a plain shirt cuff floats in from the upper right and lowers one paper card onto a small, neat stack of three paper cards, a moment before it lands.
details: The stack: three blank paper cards (#FBFAF6, ink outline) lying flat, seen from slightly above, each offset a little from the one below.
The held card is the same size, pinched at one edge between thumb and fingers and tilted slightly. The berry Zenboard mark sits in its top-left corner, the only berry in the image.
One short ink ground line under the stack.
A clear gap between the held card and the stack, so the moment reads as about to place.
illustration.composition: stack slightly left of centre; the hand upper right; the cuff stays inside the canvas
leave_out: writing or lines on the cards
a desk, table, mug, phone or plant
a second hand or a face
